title: bhairavanukarana — bhair-p01-v02
question: Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, supreme-nectar-formed, one, high-blazing. All swallowed by the ring of shining faculties — Śiva I venerate.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, supreme-nectar-formed, one, high-blazing. All swallowed by the ring of shining faculties — Śiva I venerate.
